## PG - Test Sender (Draft, import-untested)
Run only after **PG - Inquiry Intake** is Active.
**Send with key** needs credential **PG Webhook Secret**. **Send without key** must have none.
All data is synthetic (example.com). Nothing is emailed.
Result: one PASS/FAIL row per case. Then open the pg_leads and pg_action_log tables.
